# Backup format fixtures

Sample `vcardly-backup-v1` files with fictional data, generated by `tools/backup_reference.py fixtures testdata/backup`
(the Python reference implementation of the format, shaped like Android's `java.util.zip` output).

| File | Contents | Password |
|---|---|---|
| `sample-plain.vcbackup` | 3 categories, 2 tags, 2 contacts, 2 follow-ups, My card, 1 image | none |
| `sample-encrypted.vcbackup` | the same, encrypted (one chunk) | `correct horse` |
| `sample-multichunk.vcbackup` | plus a 150 KB image, so the ciphertext spans several 64 KiB chunks | `correct horse` |

The Android unit tests (`BackupFixtureCompatTest`) and the iOS tests (`BackupTests`) both restore these files, so a backup made on
one platform is proven to open on the other. CI also checks backups written by the iOS tests with `tools/backup_reference.py verify`.
